svg.title: Muscat Amusement Park — Google satellite concept zoning
svg.desc: Original concept zones registered to a Google Maps satellite screenshot. Existing northeast junction connects by a proposed approach to the proposed internal roundabout and parking. Indicative concept boundaries, not a cadastral survey. Source areas are design labels.

g.text: حدود تخطيطية أولية — المساحات من المخطط الأصلي
Indicative concept boundary · source area labels · access subject to approval
